intro.fr: SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub azukaar/SEUM-archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell.
text.en: The GitHub repository azukaar/SEUM-archipelago, home of the SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.0.0, seule version parue au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version v1.0.0 is released, the only one as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
